Release 2026-11-04 20:12

## Changes

### Features

- devtools: add nested data search (#12522) (f69b28a1d) by @TkDodo

### Fix

- vue-query: accept shared options in imperative queries (#12525) (e7124128c) by @TkDodo
- vue-query/queryClient: preserve union narrowing in 'setQueryData' updaters for tagged query keys (#12226) (3ccb007cb) by @sukvvon
- devtools: let inline panels fill their container height (#12499) (46d0477df) by @TkDodo

### Performance

- query-devtools: virtualize query and mutation lists (#12502) (254350f9c) by @TkDodo

### Chore

- examples/solid: render 'SolidQueryDevtools' in 'auto-refetching', 'optimistic-updates' and 'prefetching' SolidStart 2 examples (#12521) (ac86d5b59) by @sukvvon
- *: move Svelte config from 'svelte.config.js' into 'vite.config.ts' (#12519) (bd4cc6515) by @sukvvon
- *: add 'UserConfig' and 'SvelteConfig' types to untyped config objects so typos are caught by type checking (#12518) (8652d3e96) by @sukvvon
- query-devtools/tsdown.config: add '@refresh skip' banner so the app's 'solid-refresh' does not wrap the bundled Solid runtime (#12517) (1176d373d) by @sukvvon
- integrations: convert to TypeScript and add 'test:types' so each integration type checks against the published types (#12516) (d5781a495) by @sukvvon
- deps: align 'catalog', 'vue' and 'next' dev ranges with examples after the security update (#12515) (e877443ca) by @sukvvon
- integrations: add missing 'preact', 'sveltekit', 'nuxt', 'solid-start' and 'astro' integrations and align existing ones (#12507) (b38ddac2b) by @sukvvon
- deps: update security dependencies in examples and integrations (#12509) (b1243facc) by @TkDodo
- *: update Angular to v22 and TypeScript to v6 in Angular examples and integration (#12506) (df4738d4e) by @sukvvon
- examples: update dependencies that pull older 'esbuild' versions (#12505) (84f5b0f5b) by @sukvvon
- pnpm-workspace.yaml: remove 'esbuild' override so each package uses its declared version (#12504) (224228917) by @sukvvon
